neighbours.label: verb or auxiliary slot saying what a process does next in a description of change over time
fire: The pump keeps running until the tank fills, and then the valve will close.
Train the network until the error stops falling, and then the loop will exit.
The nymphs shed their skin many times to reach the winged stage.
Hormone levels remain high all winter and fall steeply just before spring.
The tadpoles undergo several changes to reach the adult form.
Cooling goes on for an hour until the metal hardens, then the furnace will restart.
Sales climb through the autumn and drop sharply right after the holidays.
In midsummer at the pole the sun is at its highest point in the sky.
quiet: The pump sits in the shed next to the tank and the valve.
The network has twelve layers and the loop is written in C.
The nymphs live under stones near a cold stream.
Hormone tablets are sold in small boxes at most pharmacies.
The tadpoles in the jar belong to my younger sister.
The furnace in the old foundry is painted a dull green.
Sales staff at the shop wear blue shirts and name badges.
The pole in the yard is taller than the garden shed.

notes: Weak guess; the best probes reached 0.36-0.44 on ' to' and ' will'. The pole may not have a clean description at this depth.
